correctness.rationale: Exact edge-first-arrival exponential race gives the correct stopping graph. Conditioning on the independent first forbidden edge and the maximum of candidate-pair and complement coverage times produces all ordered matching factorial moments. Finite binomial inversion recovers probabilities. The one/two-component deletion hazards yield an exact skip-death recurrence and full expected time. Independent graph-state enumeration at n=3,4,5,6 and rational formula checks through n=13 passed 79 assertions. Boundaries N=0 and N=1 are explicitly included; finite checks are not the general proof.

value.rationale: Residual isolated pair components are exactly the natural barrier after all coupons have been observed but labels remain unidentified. Exact finite-n distribution and exact Type-II expected total recovery via polynomially many rational summands supply a structurally motivated invariant beyond a rough O(log^5 n) bound and small-n state calculations. The formula is valid for every n>=3 and does not depend on conjectured large-n behavior.
